_comment: /deploy-global merges this block into ~/.claude/settings.json idempotently (additive upsert by command — see deploy-global step 13) and copies bash-policy.json next to the script. One PreToolUse process carries every shell policy gate: four DENIES (index routing per repo, pip ban, package-manager mixing, lockfile deletion) via exit 2, then the non-blocking pre-push quality-gate reminder. `permissionDecision: allow` is emitted only inside that push branch — never globally. Policy: rules/tools/code-search.md, CLAUDE.md > Python Dependency Management / Package Manager.
